`ai-research-helper.sh` with the default `--provider auto` always goes through `call_opencode` when the `opencode` binary exists. For tier names (`simple|standard|thinking`) it resolves the model with `model_tier_candidate_for_provider "$name" openai`, so it is pinned to OpenAI.
